title: Application prefetch files
whyItMatters: Prefetch files record which executables ran and when. They give a timeline of application use even after the programs are removed.
source: SANS Windows forensic poster: %SystemDrive%/Windows/Prefetch (*.pf execution files)
notes: Machine-wide folder, so elevation is required. Only .pf files are counted; their embedded path and run-count data is never parsed.
